prompt.context: A large Mexican tile company, Azulejo, has enjoyed rapid sales growth and profitability over the last several years. However, the company's sales growth has been stagnant so far this year. The company is also concerned that it over-hired this past year and may need to reduce headcount.
prompt.question: The company requests your help to assess the current situation and to determine the optimal next steps. Specifically, what should Azulejo do to generate $5M per year in additional profits in order to avoid layoffs?

clarifying_info.q: What is Azulejo's position in the Mexican market?
clarifying_info.a: Azulejo occupies a very dominant position in the Mexican market.

clarifying_info.q: Why has growth slowed? Is this company-specific or industry-wide?
clarifying_info.a: The market growth has slowed down dramatically over the last year. Many industry experts believe the market has become saturated.

clarifying_info.q: What is the profit target needed to avoid layoffs?
clarifying_info.a: Azulejo needs to find a way to generate $5M per year in additional profits to avoid layoffs.

clarifying_info.q: Does Azulejo have any options for geographic expansion?
clarifying_info.a: Azulejo has the ability to move into other markets. It has access to a warehouse in McAllen, Texas (southern part of the state) where it could store its tiles for US distribution.

clarifying_info.q: What are the costs associated with US expansion?
clarifying_info.a: Fixed Costs: Warehouse ($600k/year), US workforce ($350k/year), trucks and drivers ($500k/year). Variable Costs: Cost per tile ($0.50/tile), Sales Cost ($0.08/tile), Shrink ($0.02/tile), Shipping ($0.10/tile). This list is exhaustive of all costs.

clarifying_info.q: What is the size of the US tile market?
clarifying_info.a: Total US market size is 400 million tiles per year.

clarifying_info.q: What is the revenue per tile in the US?
What market share could Azulejo capture in the US?
clarifying_info.a: Expected market capture for Azulejo is 8% within three years.

framework: Diagnose why sales growth has stagnated — market saturation in Mexico vs. company-specific issues
Assess financial implications of retaining vs. laying off employees
Identify strategies to generate $5M in additional annual profit
Evaluate geographic expansion (US market entry) as primary growth lever
Consider product mix changes to compete in new segments within Mexico
Analyze US expansion financials: revenue, variable contribution, fixed costs, and net profit
Compare profit from US expansion against $5M target
Develop entry strategy and assess competitive risks

questions.prompt: Calculate the profit Azulejo would generate from entering the US tile market, assuming 8% market share captured within three years. Should Azulejo enter the US market?
questions.guidance: Candidate should calculate total US market revenue, Azulejo's share in tiles, Azulejo's revenue, then subtract both variable and fixed costs to arrive at profit. Must identify all variable cost components and sum fixed costs correctly. Should compare result to $5M profit target and give a clear yes/no recommendation.

math.setup: US Market = 400M tiles/year; Azulejo share = 8%; Revenue per tile = $1.30; Variable costs = $0.50 + $0.08 + $0.02 + $0.10 = $0.70/tile; Fixed costs = $600k + $350k + $500k = $1.45M/year
steps: NPV (at 0% discount rate) excess above target = $17.75M - $5M = $12.75M
math.answer: Azulejo profit from US expansion = $17.75M/year, which exceeds the $5M profit target by $12.75M. Yes, Azulejo should enter the US tile market.

brainstorming.prompt: Beyond US expansion, what other strategies could Azulejo consider to generate growth or protect profitability?

categories.name: Geographic Expansion
ideas: Enter US market via McAllen, Texas warehouse
Explore other Latin American markets (e.g., Central America)
Target export markets beyond North America

categories.name: Product Mix / Differentiation
ideas: Shift to higher-margin premium tile segments within Mexico
Introduce new product lines (e.g., specialty or decorative tiles)

categories.name: Cost Reduction
ideas: Operational efficiency improvements to reduce cost per tile
Reduce headcount in lowest-productivity areas if growth strategies are insufficient

categories.name: Market Development within Mexico
ideas: Target underserved regional markets within Mexico
Partner with large construction or real estate developers

categories.name: Competitive Strategy
ideas: Preempt competitor entry into US market by establishing distribution first
Use dominant Mexican market position to negotiate better input costs

recommendation: Azulejo should enter the US tile market via the McAllen, Texas warehouse
The US expansion generates $17.75M in annual profit, well above the $5M target needed to avoid layoffs
This also provides a structural growth engine beyond the saturated Mexican market
risks: Competitive response from established US tile manufacturers who have existing distribution and brand recognition
Execution risk in building a new distribution and sales capability in a foreign market
Currency and trade risk between Mexico and the US
Demand projections (8% market share) may be optimistic and take longer than three years to achieve
next_steps: Conduct detailed market research to validate 8% market share assumption and identify target customer segments in the US
Develop a phased US market entry plan starting with McAllen, Texas region
Assess competitive landscape of US tile market and identify key potential customers (contractors, distributors, retailers)
Establish sales and distribution team in the US; leverage existing Mexican operations for supply chain
Set milestones and KPIs for year 1-3 US market performance
